messages:
Miranda (Design): Quick microcopy check  noticed the inline error on Routes when a save fails. Current helper reads `If this keeps happening contact support` (no punctuation) and action is `Retry`.
Sam (PM): Agree this reads off. `Retry` feels ambiguous and the helper missing punctuation looks unpolished.
Priya (Copy): Suggestion: make it a full sentence and clearer. Proposed helper: "We couldn't save your changes. Try again, or contact support." Primary button: "Try again". Alternative button label: "Save again" if we want more explicitness.
Alex (Eng): Technically fine to update. Note the inline-action uses the global component; changing label and aria-label is quick. If we pick `Save again` we should make sure it matches other save CTAs.
Jordan (A11y): For screen reader clarity, add a specific aria-label on the button, e.g., aria-label="Retry save" or "Retry saving route". Also ensure helper text referenced with aria-describedby by the control.
Miranda (Design): Visual preference: "Try again" keeps the UI consistent. We'll add aria-label="Retry save" on the button and ensure helper ends with a period.
Priya (Copy): For the support link, keep it short: "contact support" and make it an inline link to the docs page.
Sam (PM): Do we want a secondary link like "View logs" or "Open diagnostics"?
Alex (Eng): Adding another action increases scope; I'd rather ship copy+ARIA now and iterate if customers ask for diagnostics.
Jordan (A11y): When retrying, announce status via aria-live: change text to "Trying again\u2026" and set aria-busy="true". Use the single ellipsis char so SRs read it as ongoing.
Priya (Copy): Final microcopy bundle agreed:
- Helper: "We couldn't save your changes. Try again, or contact support."
- Primary CTA: "Try again" with aria-label="Retry save"
- In-progress text: "Trying again\u2026" (aria-live polite)
Miranda (Design): I'll update the Figma variant and leave a note about focus order. Priya, can you add this to /docs/microcopy/inline-errors.md and include alt text for the screenshot?
Priya (Copy): Adding now, will ping when pushed.
Sam (PM): If no objections I'll mark ready and assign to Eng.
Alex (Eng): I'll pick this up tomorrow morning. Thanks for the clear copy + ARIA notes.
